name: Musco Sports Lighting, LLC
old_description: Since 2023, Bullitt County Public Schools has standardized the lighting performance across its athletic facilities at North, Central, and East High Schools. They’ve invested in Musco LED systems for football, baseball, softball, and tennis, with tailored solutions for new installations and retrofit applications. Additionally, each football stadium now features color-changing luminaires and Show-Light® entertainment technology.
about:
Musco Sports Lighting, LLC is headquartered in Oskaloosa, Iowa. Founded over half a century ago, the company has grown from its Iowa roots into a global provider of sports and large-area lighting systems.

The company designs and manufactures LED lighting systems for sports venues, transportation infrastructure, entertainment facilities, and videoboard installations. Its proprietary platforms include the Light-Structure System™, 5 Easy Pieces™ packaged solutions, and the Mini-Pitch System™ for community recreation. Musco also provides the Control-Link® remote monitoring service, which offers 24/7 proactive system oversight and remote on/off control. The firm employs more than 2,100 team members worldwide and reports that each Mini-Pitch System™ impacts approximately 10,000 youth.

Musco serves K–12 school districts, universities, municipal parks departments, professional sports clubs, and international governing bodies. Recent projects include lighting upgrades for Blackpool FC’s Bloomfield Road stadium in England, the Gaelic Athletic Association’s Croke Park in Dublin, Chimney Park ball fields in Windsor, Colorado, and the University of Idaho’s multi-use facility. In 2023, Bullitt County Public Schools in Kentucky standardized on Musco LED systems for football, baseball, softball, and tennis across three high schools. The company was also named the Official Sport Presentation and Broadcast Lighting Provider for the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Musco’s founding principle states that the company exists for the benefit of its team, a philosophy it credits for decades-long employee retention. The firm emphasizes responsible lighting that minimizes spill light and glare, protects the night sky, and reduces energy consumption. It also assists customers with project planning, funding identification, financing options, and long-term warranty support.

name: Myriad Semiconductor Manufacturing Division
old_description: Our business concept is based upon building long-term, mutually beneficial business relationships. Our success in achieving our stated goals is best measured by our longevitiy.  Since 1983 Myriad has proven its desire and ability to meet the ever-changing expectations of our diverse industry.
about:
Myriad Semiconductor Manufacturing Division was founded in 1983 in Garfield, Arkansas, by owner Bobby Hobbs. The company began with a focus on building long-term, mutually beneficial business relationships in the semiconductor equipment sector.

Myriad designs and manufactures custom configured mask aligners for production, research and development, and university teaching environments. It also remanufactures existing Kasper and Quintel mask aligners to extend equipment life. The company maintains a large inventory of spare parts for semiconductor processing equipment, as well as electronic, electrical, and mechanical components such as integrated circuits, transistors, capacitors, sensors, and switches. Additional services include printed circuit board repair, field service, and training. Surplus inventory is sold through an eBay storefront.

The company serves semiconductor production facilities, R&D laboratories, and academic institutions worldwide. Its mask aligner systems are used in production, R&D, and university teaching environments, and it has supported production customers across the globe for over three decades.

Myriad emphasizes longevity as a measure of success, citing more than 31 years of global client service and a reputation for high-quality products and support. Its business concept centers on long-term relationships rather than short-term transactions.

NCAB serves OEM, ODM, and EMS customers in aerospace, automotive, datacom, defense, industrial, medical, power/energy, railway, safety-critical, and telecom sectors. The company emphasizes close collaboration from the design phase to ensure reliability for demanding applications.

NCAB’s stated mission is to deliver PCBs on time with zero defects, produced sustainably at the lowest total cost. It positions itself as taking full responsibility for the PCB lifecycle, aiming to make customers more resilient, agile, and sustainable through supply-chain competence and delivery accuracy.

name: NOLA Steele Fabrication and Erection
old_description: With more than 20 years in the industry, President Karen L. Williams founded NOLA Steele Fabrication and Erection LLC in 2014.
about:
NOLA Steele Fabrication and Erection LLC was founded in 2014 by Karen L. Williams in Harvey, Louisiana. Williams brought more than two decades of construction industry experience, having risen from office manager to vice president before launching her own firm. The company is certified as a woman-owned, service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), and also holds 8(a), DBE, MBE, WBE, and EDWOSB designations. Her husband, Travis Williams, a service-connected disabled veteran with 15 years in the U.S. Army, serves as vice president and estimator.

The company provides design, steel fabrication, structural steel erection, repair welding, ornamental iron, limited steel demolition, and miscellaneous steel work such as handrails, guardrails, balconies, and stair stringers. It also supplies steel products and furnishes skilled labor including welders, fitters, riggers, tackers, ironworkers, painters, and sandblasters. NOLA Steele operates with a team of about 35 trained professionals and has completed more than 500 projects since inception.

Clients include government agencies such as the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and the Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport, as well as municipalities, nonprofit organizations, and commercial contractors throughout Southeast Louisiana.

Williams established the firm with a mission of superior quality, craftsmanship, and customer satisfaction, emphasizing a thorough quality control program and a vision to train and certify new welders. The company stresses that it is fully licensed, insured, and bonded, and aims to deliver projects on time and within budget.

name: Nashville Electric Service - Music City Solar
old_description: The city spoke. We listened. Thanks to the voice of our customers, what once was a landfill off I-65 is now the site of Nashville's first community solar park that includes 17,020 panels, available to participating customers, marking an important step in offering clean, efficient, maintenance-free energy.
about:
Music City Solar is a community solar program operated by Nashville Electric Service (NES), a publicly owned utility headquartered in Madison, Tennessee. The program was launched on August 1, 2018, when the utility transformed a former landfill off Interstate 65 into Nashville’s first community solar park. NES developed the project in direct response to customer demand for renewable energy options.

The solar park comprises 17,020 photovoltaic panels and feeds clean electricity directly into the NES grid. Residential and commercial customers can subscribe to individual panels and receive a monthly bill credit for the energy produced through 2038. As of the latest data, 3,142 panels have been leased, generating over 21 million kilowatt-hours, while 12,863 panels remain available for subscription. The utility also administers the Solar Angel Fund, which accepts tax-deductible donations to provide energy assistance for low-income households; 1,015 panels have been donated to that effort.

The program serves NES’s residential and small-business customers across the Nashville metro area, including renters who cannot install rooftop systems. It also partners with The Community Foundation of Middle Tennessee to distribute Solar Angel funds locally. Pinnacle Financial Partners is noted as a financial collaborator.

NES frames the initiative as a way to align the utility’s offerings with the city’s rapid growth and environmental goals. By locating the array on a reclaimed landfill and requiring no maintenance from subscribers, the program aims to make solar participation accessible and maintenance-free while fostering community engagement through shared energy credits and charitable giving.

name: National Molding
old_description: Global Manufacturer of Precision Engineered Plastic Components
about:
National Molding was founded in 1982 in Miami Lakes, Florida. The company began as an injection molding specialist and developed the proprietary Hetero-Cavity technology that remains central to its operations.

Today National Molding operates plants in the United States, Canada, and China, producing over 3.5 billion precision plastic parts annually. Its manufacturing capabilities span precision injection molding (40–300 ton machines), medical molding in an ISO Class 8 cleanroom, insert and over molding, metal-to-plastic conversions, low-cost modular molding, and a full-service tool room with CNC machining. The company also provides design for manufacturability, material science support, pre- and post-molding services, and assembly.

The customer base is diverse: over 60 percent of output serves Tier 1, Tier 2, and OEM automotive programs. The remainder includes DuraflexUSA buckles and fasteners for sporting goods, pet supplies, and military/tactical markets; sophisticated release systems for body armor used by military and law enforcement; and medical devices and assemblies for healthcare, life science, dental, and diagnostic sectors. Commercial clients span plumbing fixtures, telecommunications, appliances, irrigation, furniture, marine, and electrical products.

National Molding differentiates itself through its Hetero-Cavity® system, which enables high-volume production of small, complex parts with minimal lead time, and through its global footprint that supports Berry Amendment and Buy America Act compliance for domestic programs.
